sources.lesson: Composite prediction/tracking update, learned disturbance representation. Public repo contains offline training/data tools, not the complete online flight controller.
sources.boundary: Requires a causal noisy force-residual measurement and matching stability assumptions; not reproduced by merely changing the encoder.

sources.lesson: Learned policy with reference preview and an L1 velocity predictor; inspected adaptation source uses dt=0.02 and alpha=0.99.
sources.boundary: Full policy replaces more than the allowed position residual block. Default estimator low-pass bandwidth is not evidence of 2.2-4.8 Hz disturbance tracking.

sources.lesson: Measurement/control/actuator filtering must preserve consistent delay; current institutional code initializes synchronized IMU and actuator-state filters.
sources.boundary: The inspected indiFlight research fork is not the 2018 paper's exact Paparazzi implementation; replacing the attitude loop is outside current scope.
